description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances; it is required for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 场景联动规则内容。格式详情请参见[场景联动规则编写说明](~~171059~~)。
description.en: The content of the scene orchestration rule. For format details, see [scene orchestration rule writing guide](~~171059~~).

description.zh: 场景联动规则描述。长度不超过100个字符。
description.en: The description of the scene orchestration rule. The length cannot exceed 100 characters.

description.zh: 场景联动规则名称。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度限制为1~30个字符。
description.en: The name of the scene orchestration rule. It can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase English letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The length must be 1 to 30 characters.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API per Alibaba Cloud account is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
